description.value: Tofino Electric Bikes bills itself as Tofino's first e-bike rental company, offering Class-1 pedal-assisted step-through bikes for exploring the Pacific Rim National Park coastline and the trail corridor between Tofino and Ucluelet. Operating out of two locations — downtown at 435 Main St and at Surf Grove Campground on Maltby Road — they make it easy for visitors without their own bikes to access the region's dedicated cycling routes. Each rental comes with a helmet, lock, bell, and small cargo bag.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an e-bike rental operation at 435 Main St, Tofino, with phone 1-250-522-0203 matching OSM. The site is detailed about rental logistics (Class-1 pedal-assist bikes, included equipment, two pickup locations) but contains no mention of mechanical repair services, pumps, washrooms, or amenities beyond the rental itself. Bike rentals are unambiguously confirmed; all other amenities default to null for lack of evidence.
concerns: Neither required criterion (urgent mechanicals help, pump availability) is confirmed — website focuses entirely on rentals with no mention of repair or workshop services. Directory editors should verify whether staff can assist passing cyclists with basic mechanical triage.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate cycling tourism business offering e-bike rentals in a high-demand destination; directly useful to touring cyclists who want to explore the Tofino–Ucluelet corridor without their own bikes. Required mechanical criteria are unconfirmed but absence of evidence is not disqualifying for a rental-focused listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business operates two pickup locations: 435 Main St (downtown Tofino) and Surf Grove Campground (Maltby Road). Overnight rentals require secure indoor storage per their policy. Minimum rider age is 16 per BC law.

Bike rentals.detail: Fleet of Class-1 pedal-assisted step-through e-bikes available for rent; two pickup locations (downtown Main St and Surf Grove Campground); walk-ins welcome, online booking available; rentals include helmet, lock, bell, and small cargo bag
